# whole point: a ladder checked against itself proves only that it is
# self-consistent, and the failure that matters is a column the port spells
# differently from the column the archive actually has.

#     \"SELECT type||' '||name||' :: '||COALESCE(REPLACE(REPLACE(sql,char(10),' '),'  ',' '),'(auto)') \
#       FROM sqlite_master ORDER BY type, name\""
index edits_clip :: CREATE INDEX edits_clip ON edits(clip_id) WHERE clip_id IS NOT NULL
index edits_source :: CREATE INDEX edits_source ON edits(source_id) WHERE source_id IS NOT NULL
index idx_capture_events_utc :: CREATE INDEX idx_capture_events_utc ON capture_events (utc)
index live_lines_start :: CREATE INDEX live_lines_start ON live_lines(start_utc, text)
index rendered_audio :: CREATE INDEX rendered_audio ON rendered_lines(audio_segment_id)
index rendered_clip :: CREATE INDEX rendered_clip ON rendered_lines(clip_id)
index rendered_live :: CREATE INDEX rendered_live ON rendered_lines(live_id) WHERE live_id IS NOT NULL
index rendered_source_start :: CREATE INDEX rendered_source_start ON rendered_lines(source_id, start_utc, id)
index rendered_start :: CREATE INDEX rendered_start ON rendered_lines(start_utc, id)
index speakers_owner_name :: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX speakers_owner_name ON speakers (ifnull(owner, ''), name)

index vocabulary_owner_term :: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX vocabulary_owner_term ON vocabulary (ifnull(owner, ''), term)
table audio_segments :: CREATE TABLE audio_segments (     id     INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,     source_id  TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES sources(id),     path    TEXT NOT NULL,     start_utc  TEXT NOT NULL,     end_utc   TEXT NOT NULL,     sample_rate INTEGER NOT NULL,     channels  INTEGER NOT NULL,     UNIQUE (source_id, start_utc)   )
table capture_events :: CREATE TABLE capture_events (     id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,     utc TEXT NOT NULL,     kind TEXT NOT NULL,     source_id TEXT,     detail TEXT   )
table deleted_segments :: CREATE TABLE deleted_segments (     id     INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,     source_id  TEXT NOT NULL,     start_utc  TEXT NOT NULL,     deleted_utc TEXT NOT NULL,     UNIQUE (source_id, start_utc)   )
table edits :: CREATE TABLE edits (     id    INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,     at_us   INTEGER NOT NULL,     act    TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (json_valid(act)),     clip_id  INTEGER,     source_id TEXT,     origin  TEXT   )
table live_lines :: CREATE TABLE live_lines (     id     INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,     start_utc  TEXT NOT NULL,     end_utc   TEXT NOT NULL,     text    TEXT NOT NULL,     language  TEXT,     asr_model  TEXT NOT NULL,     created_utc TEXT   )
table rendered_clips :: CREATE TABLE rendered_clips (     clip_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,     inputs TEXT NOT NULL   )
table rendered_fts :: CREATE VIRTUAL TABLE rendered_fts USING fts5(text, content='rendered_lines', content_rowid='id')
table rendered_fts_config :: CREATE TABLE 'rendered_fts_config'(k PRIMARY KEY, v) WITHOUT ROWID
table rendered_fts_data :: CREATE TABLE 'rendered_fts_data'(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, block BLOB)
table rendered_fts_docsize :: CREATE TABLE 'rendered_fts_docsize'(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, sz BLOB)
table rendered_fts_idx :: CREATE TABLE 'rendered_fts_idx'(segid, term, pgno, PRIMARY KEY(segid, term)) WITHOUT ROWID
table rendered_lines :: CREATE TABLE "rendered_lines" (     id        INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,     clip_id     INTEGER,     audio_segment_id INTEGER,     source_id    TEXT,     start_utc    TEXT NOT NULL,     end_utc     TEXT NOT NULL,     text       TEXT NOT NULL,     language     TEXT,     asr_confidence  REAL,     asr_model    TEXT,     speaker_label  TEXT,     speaker_guess  TEXT,     speaker_score  REAL,     speaker_cluster TEXT,     tier       TEXT NOT NULL,     hidden_reason  TEXT,     words_checked  INTEGER,     edit_id     INTEGER,     live_id     INTEGER,     word_timings   TEXT   )
table settings :: CREATE TABLE settings (     key  TEXT PRIMARY KEY,     value TEXT NOT NULL   )
table sources :: CREATE TABLE sources (     id  TEXT PRIMARY KEY,     name TEXT NOT NULL,     kind TEXT NOT NULL   , owner TEXT)
table speaker_embeddings :: CREATE TABLE "speaker_embeddings" (     id          INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,     speaker_id      INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES "speakers"(id),     vector        TEXT NOT NULL,     created_utc     TEXT NOT NULL,     source_correction_id INTEGER,     source_segment_id  INTEGER,     source_edit_id    INTEGER   )
table speakers :: CREATE TABLE "speakers" (     id  INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,     owner TEXT,     name TEXT NOT NULL   )
table sqlite_sequence :: CREATE TABLE sqlite_sequence(name,seq)
table transcribed_before_jobs :: CREATE TABLE transcribed_before_jobs (     audio_segment_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY   )
table vocabulary :: CREATE TABLE "vocabulary" (     id     INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,     owner    TEXT,     term    TEXT NOT NULL,     created_utc TEXT NOT NULL   )

trigger rendered_fts_delete :: CREATE TRIGGER rendered_fts_delete AFTER DELETE ON rendered_lines BEGIN     INSERT INTO rendered_fts (rendered_fts, rowid, text) VALUES ('delete', old.id, old.text);   END
